question:

D4C3B2A1, H8G7F6E5, L12K11J10I9, ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55ce9e5672c8058a7519d794e807062d94e7f043bba4a18a70fff96b90ad6db9.png]
